dedupe_keys.name: oppla eu repository of nature based solutions knowledge and case studies

description: Oppla is an open platform for knowledge on natural capital, ecosystem services and nature-based solutions, where individuals and project groups discover, share and create case studies, resources, articles and events. It began in 2016 as a collaboration between the EU research projects OPERAs and OpenNESS to keep environmental research outputs permanently accessible, and in 2019 the European Commission's Directorate General for Research and Innovation recognised it as the EU Nature-Based Solutions Knowledge Repository. It holds over 400 case studies and over 1,000 resources contributed by a community of more than 5,000 members, and groups let finished projects archive their outputs; the former NetworkNature address now redirects to it. Coverage is global with a European core, and a sister platform, Naturaleza Transformativa, launched with Instituto Humboldt in Colombia in 2024. Content is accessible online as free HTML pages; contributors keep ownership and grant Oppla a non-exclusive licence to display it, and the terms forbid automated scraping. Caveats: entries are self-reported by contributors, vary in depth and evidence, and have no single data schema or bulk export. It supports scoping of nature-based solutions and green and blue infrastructure options for climate adaptation and hazard reduction; related records are the Climate-ADAPT case studies, such as the Augustenborg and Paris OASIS cases.
